headline: 'AI for All' launches: youth literacy in, regulation out
digest: The federal AI for All strategy launched on June 4. Institutes (CIFAR, Mila, Amii) welcomed expanded AI Chairs, the FLAIR Indigenous-language program and literacy commitments. Actua welcomed youth AI literacy and $30M for CanCode but noted Canada ranks 42nd of 47 on AI literacy and that CanCode support is lower than before. Michael Geist called it big-spending but thin on regulation; Global News asked what 'AI from kindergarten' means when curriculum is provincial. United for Literacy flagged adult literacy (one in five working-age adults struggles) as an AI equity issue.
